svg.title: Every Opus bug-fix run, step by step
svg.desc: Claude Opus 5.5, all 48 bug-fix runs in recorded order, each row lined up on its first source edit; steps in order, not to time scale. Steps come from a logging wrapper around python in both arms and a file watcher; nothing in the prompt asked for tests. A failing-test mark right of the line was shown by undoing the fix briefly. Running the unfixed code counts as reproducing the bug only when its output showed the bug: the one run without Compound that ran it first ran only the existing tests, which pass. The scorecard's 17 is the pre-registered detector, which missed three refund runs that printed the wrong total as -$99.99; the arm-blind AI labellers counted the same 20 runs this chart shows.
